content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-actually-how-works-2|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-which-architecture-actually|Payment Gateways]]s-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-10|payments]], Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-7. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets using crypto payments represents a shift in how digital creators can monetize their work. By utilizing platforms that support crypto transactions, creators can bypass traditional restrictions imposed by popular payment processors. This method not only enables creators to retain more revenue—given that NOWPayments charges just 0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10%—but also grants them full control over their transactions. In a climate where financial isolation is common, this infrastructure is vital for fostering economic independence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for selling design assets with crypto payments relies on a combination of free tools and services that ensure seamless transactions and ownership. Key components include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for product listings, with backend logic powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage can be managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, while digital products are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This stack not only minimizes operational costs but also enhances the creator's sovereignty over their digital storefront.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where payment gateways are limited or non-existent. Whether you create ebooks, templates, fonts, or courses, this solution empowers you to sell directly to your audience without the constraints of conventional platforms. By leveraging crypto payments, creators can tap into a growing market of users who prefer digital currencies, ensuring they can sell their work globally without financial barriers or platform fees.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings with NOWPayments compared to 90% with Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of a digital storefront using crypto payments hinges on well-integrated components. First, a reliable hosting service provides the foundation for product listings. Next, backend logic ensures that payment verification and order management are handled efficiently. Finally, the delivery of digital products must be automated to provide a seamless customer experience. Each piece, from the payment processor like NOWPayments to the file delivery system, works in concert to create a cohesive and effective sales infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with selling design assets through crypto payments, follow a few straightforward steps. First, choose your hosting platform, like GitHub Pages, and set up your product listings. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers to manage transactions. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing and configure your product delivery system. Finally, ensure everything is tested thoroughly before launching your digital storefront. This streamlined approach allows you to bypass conventional payment limitations and start selling quickly.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Bypass platform limitations and sell digital assets directly to your customers.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider exploring The Sovereign Blueprint ($47). This resource offers complete documentation on deploying a crypto-enabled digital storefront, along with source code and integration guides. Check out the options available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using a crypto payment processor such as NOWPayments. This allows you to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies while avoiding the limitations of traditional platforms like PayPal and Stripe.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

To sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees, consider using tools that facilitate direct sales through crypto payments. This approach minimizes transaction costs, allowing you to retain more of your revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own digital storefront using a combination of free tools and crypto payment processing. This gives you full control over sales and reduces dependency on external platforms.
Are there specific cryptocurrencies I should accept?

It's advisable to accept popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. These currencies have broad acceptance and can be processed efficiently through payment processors like NOWPayments.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% for processing transactions, significantly less than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This means more revenue stays in your pocket.
